subject: AWS private offer activation & co-sell onboarding — CloudResell / ACME
messages:
From: Sarah Lin <sarah@cloudresell.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>
Cc: AWS Marketplace Partner Team <aws-marketplace@amazon.com>
Date: 2027-04-25T14:12:00Z
Subject: Kickoff: AWS private offer for ACME - what we need from Redwood

Hi Diego,

Thanks again for the quick intro earlier. ACME is ready to move forward with the private offer via CloudResell and AWS CPPO, but AWS needs a few items from Redwood to get the offer published and for us to enable co-sell. Can you confirm you can provide the following and the earliest ETA?

- Seller account ID and offer/account admin contact
- Target SKUs and per-unit pricing (list and an attached quote would be great)
- Billing terms (net 30 / PO instructions)
- Technical contact for onboarding (for entitlement and usage mapping)
- Any commercial attachments AWS needs (ex: reseller consent form)

We attached our CPPO checklist to speed things up. If easier, happy to hop on a 30-min call tomorrow.

Best,
Sarah Lin
Head of Partnerships, CloudResell
(sarah@cloudresell.com)

Attachments: CloudResell-CPPO-Checklist.xlsx

From: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Lin <sarah@cloudresell.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-26T09:04:00Z
Subject: Re: Kickoff: AWS private offer for ACME - what we need from Redwood

Hi Sarah — thanks for the checklist and the clear list. We're ready to proceed and I mapped owners below with rough ETAs: 

- Seller account ID & contact: Ben Carter will send seller ID + admin contact by EOD tomorrow (2027-04-27).
- SKUs & pricing quote: I'll attach a draft quote + price bands; Marissa to sign off on any discount exceptions. ETA for doc: 2027-04-27 afternoon.
- Billing terms: We accept PO + net 30 by default. If ACME needs a deviation we'll route to Finance — Marissa, looping you for approvals.
- Technical contact: Laura in Onboarding (cc'd in next thread) will be primary; temporary contact is myself (diego) for entitlements mapping.
- Reseller consent/commercial attachments: Ben will include our standard reseller consent stub.

If AWS needs the offer published by May 3 to make their co-sell deadline, we should lock pricing by 2027-04-28. Propose a 20-minute sync Wed 2027-04-27 14:00 PT to finalize. Is that workable?

Cheers,
Diego Fernandez
Channel Partnerships Manager, Redwood Inference
Diego.Fernandez@redwood.com

Attachments referenced: (none in this message)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>

Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Sarah Lin <sarah@cloudresell.com>
Date: 2027-04-27T11:22:00Z
Subject: Re: Kickoff: AWS private offer for ACME - commercial ok pending final price

Diego / Ben —

Quick note from finance/commercial: we can accept the standard reseller flow and net-30 PO. For this deal I can approve up to a 22% discount off list without exec sign-off. If CloudResell asks for deeper concessions, we need to route a short memo to RevOps.

Ben — please produce the formal quote PDF and include two price tiers: 1) 12-month annualized commit (preferred) and 2) month-to-month list price. Put the estimated ARR and HubSpot deal id on the quote.

Also Diego: include the Redwood seller account ID in the quote header so AWS publishing is straightforward.

Marissa Cole
Director, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: (none)

Date: 2027-04-27T16:08:00Z
Subject: Draft quote and CPPO artifacts for ACME

Sarah / Diego —

Please find attached the draft quote and the PDF we plan to upload to AWS Marketplace: MA-PrivateOffer-Quote-ACME-20270427.pdf. Key callouts:

- Two SKUs: inference-hour (on-demand) and inference-commit (monthly reserved).
- Tier A pricing: 22% off list for a 12-month commitment (ARR estimate included).
- Billing: Redwood will invoice CloudResell (reseller) per the re-sell agreement; ACME will issue PO against the private offer on AWS.
- Seller account ID: 123456789012 (included in quote header)

Next steps we need from CloudResell / ACME:
1) Confirm acceptance of tiers and final list of SKUs by 2027-04-28 EOD.
2) ACME PO to match pricing line items and reference offer id once published.
3) CloudResell to coordinate final datasource with AWS listing team (we copied aws-marketplace)

Ben Carter

ben_carter@redwood.com

Thanks Ben — the quote looks good. Quick updates from ACME:

- They prefer the 12-month commitment (Tier A) and will issue a PO next week.
- Procurement asked for a short form master reseller letter — we attached an example and the CloudResell team will sign.
- AWS asked for the final offer payload (SKUs, prices, seller ID) to be sent to aws-marketplace@amazon.com with the subject: "Private Offer: Redwood / ACME / CloudResell".

We have a placeholder for the PO and expected date 2027-05-04. Can you confirm Redwood can publish the private offer by 2027-05-02 if we send final confirmation by 2027-04-28 EOD?

Also sharing our signed reseller consent; attaching for your records.

Sarah

Sarah / team — thanks. Confirming Redwood will publish the private offer to AWS by 2027-05-02 provided we receive final SKU confirmation and the signed ACME PO placeholder no later than 2027-04-28 23:59 PT. Action items consolidated below: 

- CloudResell: submit final SKU list + signed reseller consent to aws-marketplace@amazon.com and cc diego_fernandez@redwood.com (by 2027-04-28 EOD) — Sarah indicated this is done.
- ACME: issue PO referencing the offer and send to procurement@redwood.example.com (target 2027-05-04).
- Redwood (Ben): finalize offer payload and upload to AWS Marketplace (target 2027-05-02).
- Marissa: sign-off on final quote if any deviation from the 22% cap is requested.

I'll create a short mutual action plan doc in Drive and paste the HubSpot deal link here so everyone has a single source of truth. HubSpot: https://hubspot.example.com/deal/59231

If AWS needs anything else (offer id placeholder, entitlement mapping file), @aws-marketplace please advise and we'll push immediately.
